title: Wear complication: Trend arrow wrong direction
body:
I'm using the FullStatus complication on my WearOS watch. The trend arrow shows the wrong direction when the BG is falling.
![PXL_20231120_212332466~2](https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/assets/2745710/2a093c2a-3b77-4553-b3c3-b771b3381cd3)

I can provide logs if needed. The arrow should point to the lower right corner instead of the lower left.

comments.body: this is caused by used font
